_comment: Same 4-mode setup as tinyclassifier_anomalydetection_4mode.json, with doublebuffer0/doublebuffer1 = 1 for both models in every mode where it's safe -- used to re-measure delta/gamma with MultiDeeploy's double-buffered-closure support (Step 2 of the concurrent-execution redesign plan) enabled, for direct comparison against the SB baseline table recorded for Step 3. CRITICAL_TASK2's doublebuffer1 is deliberately left at 0: AnomalyDetection_light at 2 cores/16000 L1 with --doublebuffer hits a genuine, isolated Deeploy-internal codegen bug (confirmed via direct generation, captured BEFORE MultiDeeploy's own channel-renaming pass even runs) where Deeploy's own --name substitution double-applies, emitting an undeclared 'AnomalyDetection_light_2_AnomalyDetection_light_2_channel_input' identifier -- reproduces identically standalone via testRunner_tiled_siracusa.py, so it's not something MultiDeeploy's fusion introduced or can work around; out of scope for this pass, tracked as a known limitation.
